answer: The raven holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the ember is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
